premise: Bee comes up from Flower covered in yellow dust and Duckling kindly offers her a bubbly bath in the pond — but Flower explains the dust is what Bee carries to the daisies so they can make seeds.
inspiration: The kind helper who helps the wrong way (folk), turned: nobody scolds, the idea was kind, and listening first is the help.
lesson: A kind idea is still kind, even when it isn't needed.
learning: Bees carry pollen from flower to flower, and that helps flowers make seeds.

en-US.title: Bee and the Yellow Dust
en-US.text: Out in the meadow, {flower:enter} Flower opened wide, and along came {bee:enter} Bee, buzzing. {bee:go on flower} {sfx:buzz} Down she landed… and up she came, {bee:face happy} yellow and dusty all over. {duckling:enter} Duckling came waddling by. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] Oh, Bee, you're so dusty! You need a bath! {duckling:go to pond} Off he went to the pond. {canvas:bubbles 0.6 8s} {duckling:go to pond by swim} {sfx:splash} Splish, splosh, bubbles everywhere! {duckling:hop x2} Come on in! {flower:wobble} [curious] Wait! said Flower. Don't wash it off. That yellow dust is from me. {bee:pulse} Bee carries it to the daisies, and brings theirs back to me. That's how we make seeds. {duckling:face sad} [sad] Oh. My bath was a silly idea. {duckling:live} He tucked his head under his wing. {flower:face happy} It was a kind idea, said Flower. Out popped Duckling with a happy {sfx:quack} quack. {bee:live} Bee hummed a thank-you tune. {duckling:face happy} [happily] Busy day? asked Duckling. The busiest! said Bee, and {bee:go to meadow} off she buzzed to the daisies.

es-ES.title: Abeja y el polvito amarillo
es-ES.text: En el prado, {flower:enter} Flor se abrió de par en par, y llegó {bee:enter} Abeja, zumbando. {bee:go on flower} {sfx:buzz} Bajó a posarse… y cuando subió, {bee:face happy} estaba toda amarilla de polvito. {duckling:enter} Patito pasaba por allí. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Ay, Abeja, qué polvorienta estás! ¡Necesitas un baño! {duckling:go to pond} Y se fue a la charca. {canvas:bubbles 0.6 8s} {duckling:go to pond by swim} {sfx:splash} ¡Chof, chof, burbujas por todas partes! {duckling:hop x2} ¡Ven, métete! {flower:wobble} [curious] ¡Espera! dijo Flor. No se lo quites. Ese polvito amarillo es mío. {bee:pulse} Abeja lo lleva a las margaritas, y me trae el suyo a mí. Así hacemos semillas. {duckling:face sad} [sad] Ah. Mi baño era una idea bobita. {duckling:live} Escondió la cabeza bajo el ala. {flower:face happy} Era una idea muy amable, dijo Flor. Patito asomó con un {sfx:quack} cua muy contento. {bee:live} Abeja tarareó una canción de gracias. {duckling:face happy} [happily] ¿Mucho trabajo? preguntó Patito. ¡Muchísimo! dijo Abeja, y {bee:go to meadow} se fue zumbando a las margaritas.

buzz.prompt: a bee buzzing close by as it lands on a flower, realistic
